tier_1_warrior.name: Tân Binh → Chiến Binh (New Recruit → Warrior)

tier_2_commander.name: Chiến Binh → Chỉ Huy (Warrior → Commander)

modules: M5: Recruitment Funnel — Online/Offline lead generation
M6: Leader DNA — DISC personality coaching
M7: PSN Management — Group formation + metric tracking
M8: Coaching Conversations — 1:1 framework + buddy system
tier_2_commander.graduation: PSN score ≥ 65 + team size ≥ 5 active members

tier_3_general.name: Chỉ Huy → Tướng Quân (Commander → General)
tier_3_general.focus: Multi-PSN Strategy + Campaign Leadership + System Thinking
modules: M9: Sun Tzu Applied — 13 chapters in sales warfare
M10: Campaign Warfare — Flash campaigns + A/B funnels
M11: Data Commander — Dashboard mastery + alert response
M12: Legacy Builder — Mentorship multiplication system
tier_3_general.graduation: 3+ active PSN lines + 75% 90-day retention + recognized by Droppii rank
